sourceSentences: [0] Tahm Kench is a difficult matchup because he get close to you to stack his passive. Furthermore his built in safety from level 6 for his carry in annoying.
[0] Tahm Kench’s tankiness and ability to devour allies can be challenging for Nautilus, but Nautilus’ own crowd control can effectively lock him down.
[0] Tahm Kench is very frustrating to play against when you're playing engage. He becomes very tanky and hard to kill.

[0] If you engage on him you won't get much out of hit due to his tankiness. If you engage on his ADC, he'll devour her and it's over. Advise: make plays elsewhere, but be aware that Tahm Kench can match your roams with his ult.
[0] His Consume is the most annoying thing about this catfish. You can lock down his ADC to force him to use Consume.
[1] Tahm Kench can swallow a full stacked (P) Nautilus with (W) if he closes in with [Q] first.

[1] Tahm Kench can also protect his allies with (W), making it difficult to target both enemy laners. However, Tahm Kench does not pose much of a threat if his (Q) does not land. Try to avoid contesting lane as a viable strategy.
[2] Engage aggressively whenever hit by Nautilus’s Dredge Line (Q).
[2] If your allies are hit with Dredge Line (Q), respond with Devour [W] to protect them from being damaged.
